description.value: Freshii is a quick-service healthy-food chain founded in Toronto in 2005, now operating in over 300 locations worldwide. The Victoria location on Douglas Street serves customizable bowls, wraps, salads, burritos, and smoothies oriented toward fresh, nutritious eating. The menu caters to a wide range of dietary needs including vegetarian options and fully customizable ingredients.
